This website contains the lab exercises for the biostatistics week of the course Molecular Medicine - Oncology. Each day has its own page with exercises to work through. Use the navigation bar on the left to open a specific lab.

## Overview

The labs follow the lecture topics day by day. Work through the R exercises first; they are designed to be solvable with the commands shown there.

| Day | Topic | Main methods |
|-----|-------|--------------|
| 1 | Linear regression | `lm()`, diagnostics, confidence intervals |
| 2 | Logistic regression | `glm(family = binomial)`, odds ratios |
| 3 | Model building, interactions, selection criteria, confounders| `lm()`, `glm(family = binomial)` | 
| 4 | Survival analysis | Kaplan–Meier, Cox models (`survival` package) |

## Before You Start

- **Software:** [R](https://www.r-project.org/) and [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) (or Positron).
- **Packages:** Lab 4 requires the `survival` package (`install.packages("survival")`). Other labs use base R.
- **Data files:** Lab exercises require data that can be found on Canvas (`Biostatsweek_data1.csv`, `data2.Rds`, `data5.Rds`). Make sure these files are downloaded and findable for R before running the code.
